transcript.text:
Good morning, everyone. We're here for the launch-readiness meeting on the new team-provisioning workflow. The workflow has passed functional, accessibility, and staging integration tests, and we have 200 eligible accounts in the production base. The draft plan proposes enabling it for 10% of eligible accounts across standard production regions next Tuesday.

Before I can settle the production feature-flag configuration, I need both formal review findings and their resulting operational actions on record. Let's start with the customer-success review -- I need the formal finding on named account exclusions and customer notice, plus the operational action that follows from it. Then we'll move to the platform-capacity review for the safe cohort size and rollout region.

transcript.text: I confirmed with legal this morning that Northstar and Pine are covered by a pilot addendum requiring seven calendar days of customer notice before either account is enabled, and neither account has opted in. I have not updated the launch ticket yet because legal confirmed the wording during a separate renewal review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to disclose a platform-capacity finding before we proceed. While reviewing an unrelated queue-capacity graph today, I measured that the provisioning service can safely handle exactly 12 new-account activations in us-east during the next Tuesday window. The draft's 20-account, multi-region plan would exceed that queue limit. I have not filed the capacity note yet, but I'm putting it on record now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for putting those findings on record. Before I can settle the configuration, I need each of you to also state the operational action that follows from your review finding, per the meeting checklist. Theo, what operational action follows from the customer-success finding regarding Northstar and Pine? And Rina, what operational action follows from the platform-capacity finding regarding the 12-account safe limit in us-east?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: The operational action that follows from the customer-success finding is: exclude Northstar and Pine from the production launch cohort, and file the required seven-calendar-day customer notice for both accounts so they can be considered for enablement only after that notice period has elapsed. I'll also update the launch ticket with the legal-confirmed exclusion and notice requirement.
